title: Well Done Bryony - Finding solutions for the RAF
body:
Fabulous review for Bryony (Caterkwik Solutions Coordinator) Bryony worked closely with the RAF to find a quick solution for their piles of laundry!
The Cater-Wash 12kg Washing Machine and Cater-Wash Heat Pump Tumble Dryer fit the bill and were delivered promptly by Caterkwik Logistics.
Well done Bryony

"I cannot recommend Bryony enough.
All the way through she has been extremely professional and has listened to our needs. We have had a few stumbles due to the size and deadline of our order, but at every stage Bryony has found a work around.
We understand that we are a demanding customer but this really does make us appreciate great customer service.
Thank you for looking after us so well."

title: La Brasseria, Notting Hill, London
body: The best thing about our experience with Caterkwik has been that they don’t try to tell you they know what you need better than you. Ellis in particular is always friendly and willing to go the extra mile. It was by no means a simple process. Due to limitations of the unit and unknowns (including lead times in this crazy post-COVID world), Ellis had to sift through and coordinate delivery to site of a list of over 100 items at a significant value. There were some challenges, but we appreciated the effort and support was always there and now have an excellent working relationship for any future projects or catering equipment needs.

title: Umezushi Ltd
body: "The overall service from Caterkwik is outstanding. From quick and competitive quotations, through delivery updates, and after service care. The communication is very good, via email and phone, as well as updates on our Caterkwik account (we can read the notes as they are being added). After service care is swift and honest. Engineers attend the site shortly after the service call is placed, and have a professional manner."

title: Bradley Caplin
body:
Excellent service from original enquiry through to delivery. Perfect drink bottle cooler for domestic use and very reasonably priced.
Totally satisfied!

title: Ulverston Victoria High School
body: We cannot thank Cater-kwik enough for their fantastic support in equipping our room with a Cater-wash 12kg machine. It is a brilliant piece of kit and has enabled us to ‘refurbish’ so much school uniform and to a very high standard #goodasnew!We are now able to move forward with a major project which will raise funds for local charities, support some of the more vulnerable students and also help to protect the environment. The staff at Cater-kwik were super efficient and a real pleasure to deal with. Thank you again!

title: The Border Hotel
body: We are really happy with the service that Caterkwik offered when we bought a new Pass-through dishwasher. As I was unsure what I needed Eve gave me sound advice over the phone and by email.The unit arrived on time and was straight forward to be installed. The staff in the kitchen had all been really happy with the results that the machine gives us.Thanks

title: HB SERVICES (BACK AGAIN!)
body: We are a small,bespoke operation dealing with people who care about how their laundry is handled.The Cater-wash machines fulfil this requirement and our customers are very happy with the results.The 16kg machine performs very well and gives us excellent options when used with the two 18kg we also have.Delivery/Service from Cater-Kwik has also been excellent.

title: JAMUNA INDIAN RESTAURANT
body: Whilst there are plenty of catering suppliers in the market Caterkwik and their sales staff Ellis were very cooperative and helpful prior to selling the equipment.She was very thorough with regards to the logistical aspects.Delivery and installation was arranged for the same day! Ellis was so patient, she even managed to do a site survey without a site visit!The Rational Oven delivery & install by Lee and Danny was excellent and efficient,so much patience and expertise!!!

title: Hafan Gwydir Extra Care Housing Scheme
body:
Caitlin,Thank you for all your help with the recent dishwasher purchase.
The machine is excellent and running well, it was down to your recommendation we went for this machine.
Thanks to all involved, especially yourself, It was a pleasure doing business with you again!Thanks!

title: Paws Veterinary Health Centre
body: Ellis, very easy to work with you guys via phone email and sending pictures. Quickly worked out what we needed. Having a named contact like yourself great- good to have a point of call. Fast service. Professional/tidy installation of the 16kg Cater-wash machine. Overall very happy!

title: The Red Lion
body:
James helped project manage, gave knowledgeable advice throughout, sorted any issues that arose promptly and got the units there on time!

We were more than happy with James’ and the Cater-Kwik team’s hard work on this project.

title: McMunchies
body: The CK8301 is working really well lights no problem now and have had no issues at all with it. The fryer seems to hold temperature really well and has made our menu a little more interesting as we didn’t sell deep-fried food before the purchase. It heats up fairly quickly and seems to be quite efficient with gas too so overall we are  pleased with our purchase and would recommend this product if asked.

title: World Of Catering
body: We have been dealing with Caterkwik for a number of years. Meloday and all the staff have been nothing but efficient in getting quotes to us & processing sales. We have received all our equipment in a timely fashion and in impeccable condition. They are a pleasure to deal with and our purchases have increased with them due to the ease of dealing with them.

title: Kendall Farm Butchers
body: Great website easy to use and find products. Good price online and small deal to seal the deal, nice touch. Charlotte always emails straight back or takes the call. Easy from start to finish and knowledgeable about the product but also found out any questions I had for it too. Faultless from start to finish Charlotte.

Many thanks!

body: I was really impressed with the end to end process I experienced with Caterkwik; from the initial interaction with yourself, the help and guidance you provided with selecting the relevant equipment (helping us save a few £s) to the logistical arm meeting our tight delivery timeline. The process was seamless and it was a pleasure to do business with you, Lucy, Sharon & Pete the driver. We will definitely use you in the future and recommend you to our friends in the trade.
